classes.notes: Fast, fragile, cheap to field. No vehicle ships in this class yet, so the target is a placeholder and nothing is checked against it.

The Eclipse is the only medium, and it ships with a machine gun on each flank — the left one the mirror of the right (D17-R26a) — so the target is its fitted budget by definition. The pair is about 22% of it. It becomes a real constraint the moment a second medium is authored (D01-R27).

The Stampede is the only heavy, and it ships with the pedestal cannon on its roof turret. Same caveat as medium: one vehicle per class means the check confirms arithmetic rather than balance until the roster grows. The cannon is about 40% of the budget, which is what the one HEAVY mount on the vehicle should cost to fill.
